query: Create real E2E tests for our NestJS Fastify auth module. Jest currently runs each spec separately, but I need a main orchestrator, feature suites, Prisma migrations, and a temporary PostgreSQL database.
Review the NestJS users E2E suite: it shares tokens between files, closes Fastify in each spec, and sometimes fails depending on Jest order.
Our forgot-password E2E must exercise the real NestJS service and database without sending an actual email. Show where the test double belongs.
Configure Jest for a NestJS API so only test/main.e2e-spec.ts is discovered and imported endpoint suites cannot execute twice.
Add E2E coverage for POST /users including invalid nested payloads, duplicate email, authentication, response schemas, and passwordHash leakage.
Migrate our NestJS E2E tests from a shared development database to an isolated PostgreSQL database created and migrated per run.
Why does my NestJS E2E pass with --runInBand but fail with multiple Jest workers? Redesign lifecycle ownership instead of hiding the issue.
Audit whether our NestJS API E2E bootstrap really matches production pipes, filters, prefix, request IDs, and Fastify readiness.
Design E2E fixtures for NestJS auth that register and login through HTTP, using seeds only for an admin state not exposed by the API.
Fix leaked handles after our NestJS E2E run without enabling forceExit; the suite uses Prisma, Fastify, and a mail transport override.
Write unit tests for a pure TypeScript currency formatter used inside a NestJS controller.
Create repository integration tests for a Prisma unique index without starting NestJS or making HTTP requests.
Set up Playwright tests for a Next.js checkout page that calls a third-party API; there is no NestJS backend in this project.
Explain how to organize providers and modules in a NestJS application using dependency injection.
Create contract tests directly against the SendGrid sandbox to verify deliverability and bounce handling.
Mock every dependency of UsersService and test createUser in isolation with Jest.
Configure Vitest for a standalone TypeScript library that has no HTTP server or NestJS application.
Run Cypress against a deployed API as a black box; we do not have access to its NestJS source or database.
Add a Drizzle migration and test its generated SQL against PostgreSQL without booting the application.
Refactor NestJS configuration to validate environment variables with Zod and inject namespaced config.
